name: Mask Door Glass Panes (French Doors)
intent: Tape off each glass pane in french doors before painting. Only fires for door_type=french. Quantity is per pane, not per door — a 15-lite french door has 15 panes per side, or 30 panes per door. Both setup (tape) and teardown (untape) tasks bundled because the unmask is fast and conceptually paired with the mask.
doctrine: 10 panes/hr setup = 6 minutes per pane to tape edges and apply paper if needed. Unmask is 2x faster (20 panes/hr) — pulling tape is fast. Only fires for french door types; the door_type gate at task level handles the conditional automatically. Module is technically tagged setup phase but contains both setup and teardown tasks; this matches the source spec's bundling and Phase 1c can split if needed.
